reasoning: A loved one discovers Jelena's condition and helps her — this is Beatriz, who fled Ragusa with her and is already established as beloved. Mortals are available so no new Character is needed. Her assistance becomes a Resource: blood bought under false pretenses.

operations.name: Butcher's Blood in Beatriz's Name
operations.description: twice a week she buys more than any household could eat and tells no one why

operations.text: Beatriz discovers what I have become and does not scream — instead she starts buying pig's blood from the butcher twice a week in her own name, and I drink it cold behind a shuttered cellar door while she keeps watch.
